channel.title: Jetspeed Administration
channel.description: The Jetspeed Administration features are mainly implemented in administrative portlets which you can access from the admin user home page by chosing the "Admin" and "Security" tabs. Here are some the most common administrative portlets from both tabs:

item.title: Global
item.description: This portlet gives general information about the portal resources utilisation

item.title: Java Runtime
item.description: Give you all the properties defined for the JVM running the application

item.title: Daemons
item.description: From this portlet you can control the various deamon threads operations. The three daemons currently implemented are the feed daemon which processes OCS feeds in order to register new RSS datasources in the portal, the disk cache daemon which periodically refreshes the cached syndicated files and the bad URL daemon which removes from the syndicated data source list the unreachable or stale URLs

item.title: User Browser
item.description: Allows you to maintain users in the portal database.

item.title: BadURLManager
item.description: Lists the URLs currently marked as unreachable by the system and allows you to manually test these URLs.
